newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Trade in Portugal's Lisnave interrupted.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Portugal's Lisnave interrupted.

text.p: Trade in Portuguese ship repairer LISNAVE-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa SA was interrupted on Lisbon bourse after a press report said the state was studying a possible partial nationalisation of the loss-making company, a bourse official said.
"The bourse decided to interrupt trade in shares of Lisnave because of a press report. As soon as the company clarifies the matter, trade will resume," the bourse official told Reuters.

Diario Economico newspaper, quoting a source in the Economy Ministry, said that under a restructuring plan for Lisnave, the group would be split by the end of this year into two groups, one of which would be controlled by the state.
The state presently owns 15 percent of Lisnave.
Economy Ministry and Lisnave officials were not immediately available.
